facts.fact: The Finance Ministry says GePG electronic payment and collection services handled EGP 8.1trn in 607.3 million transactions, including EGP 1.9trn of taxes.
The Finance Ministry says taxes are collected electronically (EGP 1.9trn) and customs revenues of EGP 829.5bn are paid electronically via the Nafeza platform.
The Finance Ministry reports electronic collection figures for May 2019 to November 2023: EGP 1.9trn taxes and EGP 829.5bn customs.
